Forecast daily highs, corrected by 0.6 °C for the difference between the forecast service and the 30-year record, reach this place's 95th percentile for the time of year on 7 days in a row, and its 99th on at least one. That line is moved up 0.4 °C for the warming this place's record shows since its middle year. 4 Nov: 24.3 °C against a usual worst of 24 °C. 5 Nov: 24.1 °C against a usual worst of 24 °C. 6 Nov: 24.1 °C against a usual worst of 24 °C. 7 Nov: 25.1 °C against a usual worst of 24 °C. 8 Nov: 25.5 °C against a usual worst of 24 °C. 9 Nov: 24.8 °C against a usual worst of 24 °C. 10 Nov: 24.8 °C against a usual worst of 24 °C.
outlooks.evidence: Open-Meteo forecast issued for 2026-11-03, compared with NASA POWER daily records for Lima, Lima Province, Peru, 1996-2025. Bias measured over 21 shared days.
outlooks.verificationRule: Checked against the daily maximum temperature NASA POWER records for these days once they are available: correct if the line was crossed on at least one day of the window, a false alarm if it was not.
